contentText: The US and Israel intensified strikes on Iran on March 3rd and 4th. Since the start of the conflict, hundreds of people have been killed in the country, including over 160 students who died in an attack on a girl school in the south of the country. The admiral in charge of US operation revealed that the first 24 hours of strikes were nearly double the shock and awe tactics used during the Iraq war in 2003.
